answer_1.quote: We aim to generate lyrics that comply with both the provided topic and melody.

answer_2.quote: We automatically assess the generated lyrics on two aspects: the quality of text and music alignment.

answer_4.quote: We used qualification tasks to recruit 120 qualified annotators who 1) have enough knowledge in song and lyric annotation, and 2) pay sufficient attention on the Mechanical Turk platform.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to evaluate the quality of the lyrics using a 1-5 Likert scale on six dimensions across musicality and text quality.
